name: Japan Culture Con
blurb: Three-day Japanese culture festival in Dubai's Burj Park with taiko, samurai shows, J-pop concerts, kimono fashion and cosplay.
notes: Season 2 ran Dec 12-14, 2025 at Burj Park. The official site's Events page is empty and the homepage still only carries the 2025 season banner, with no Season 3 dates announced anywhere, matching the fixup note.
